summary: A small wrapper that sets the theme system, defaulting to dark mode and allowing the system setting.
purpose: Lets the whole app switch between light and dark themes using a class on the page root.
why: Likely reason: the theme library works through the provider wrapper.
how: 1) Receives the app content. 2) Wraps it in the theme provider set to use the class attribute, default dark, and system mode allowed.
inputs: The child content passed in by the root layout.
outputs: The same content, now with theme control available.
risks: Dark is the default, so new users begin in dark mode. The page's body colors depend on the dark class being set.
debug: If the theme does not change, check the attribute setting and whether the dark class appears on the root element.
